trigger.event: an agent is created and switched on; it starts in 'running'

transitions.event: the agent stops and reports that it stopped, why, and what it could be doing instead
the agent is switched back on (On = yes)
the agent is switched off (On = no)

trigger.event: an agent writes the first message of a thread; it starts in 'open'

transitions.event: the thread carries something Sam has not read that Hub judges he needs to see
Sam has read it and nothing on it is outstanding
the job it belongs to reaches done or failed and nothing on it is outstanding

trigger.event: an agent is given a job; it starts in 'queued'

transitions.event: the agent picks the job up
the agent finishes and writes a real result
the agent errors or stops before finishing

trigger.action: creates a project and sets its goal

transitions.event: Sam marks the goal met and no job under the project is queued or running

trigger.event: a service is connected through the Connect a service form; it starts in 'connected'

transitions.event: a real call to the service is refused because its token or key is no longer valid
the service is reconnected and a real call to it succeeds

trigger.event: a document is uploaded; it starts in 'received'

transitions.event: Hands fills the fields it can
Sam approves at the Trust Gate
the completed copy is written and attested

trigger.event: an agent reaches an irreversible action — sending an email, paying for something

Cost.data_source: What did the hosted model calls cost?

Gmail.purpose: Sam's real email — the email agent reads it and drafts replies into it.

timing.event: a message arrives, or Sam commands the agent from inside the thread

Google Calendar.purpose: what is coming up, so the desk can plan around it.

timing.event: the calendar surface is opened, or an agent needs the day's shape

Tavily search.purpose: web search for the agents that need to look something up.

timing.event: an agent runs a job that needs the web

Model providers.purpose: the LLMs the agents run on — Ollama locally, hosted only where speed forces it.
